newsitem.title: USA: Banta to buy Atlanta specialty printer.
newsitem.headline: Banta to buy Atlanta specialty printer.

text.p: Banta Corp said Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Dittler Brothers Inc, an Atlanta-based specialty printer of direct marketing materials, promotional games, lottery tickets, airline timetables and hotel directories.
Terms were not disclosed, but based on Dittler's current performance, Banta said it expects the acquisition to be moderately accretive on an earnings per share basis in fiscal 1997.
It said Dittler operates two plants in the Atlanta area and reported 1995 sales of $104 million.
Completion of the transaction is expected early next year.
